ERA5-Land is licensed under
[CC-BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes made: the
monthly fields (total precipitation, 2 m air temperature, snow depth water
equivalent) were subset to the study domain, converted to millimetres and
degrees Celsius, averaged over each study region with cos(latitude) area
weights, and aggregated into seasonal totals, means and anomalies.
